text.p: LONDON - The Bank of England will publish minutes of the first meeting of its interest rate setting Monetary Policy Committee at 0830 GMT.
The meeting, which took place on June 5 and 6, resulted in a 1/4 point rise in official British interest rates to 6.5 percent.
The MPC then increased interest rates again at last week's meeting. They currently stand at 6.75 percent.
Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown empowered the committee to set interest rates in May.
